title: Evaluating AI-Generated Facial Expressions as Affective Interface Cues: Multimodal Analysis Code (Questionnaire, fNIRS, Eye-Tracking, Bayesian)
description: Analysis code (R) for a within-participant multimodal comparison of selected AI-generated and human facial-expression stimuli across seven intended emotion categories. Questionnaire ratings, prefrontal oxyhemoglobin responses recorded with functional near-infrared spectroscopy, and eye-tracking metrics are each analysed with a two-way Emotion x Source repeated-measures ANOVA with within-participant error strata, partial eta squared, Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate control across the dependent measures within each effect, Greenhouse-Geisser sensitivity checks, and Bonferroni post-hoc source contrasts within each emotion category. Exploratory Bayesian correlations between subjective ratings and physiological indices are reported with a simulated chance-yield benchmark. No participant data are included.
